C0129.title: Refund-Only Scam Nets 4 Million Yuan from Merchants, Fraudster Sentenced to 6 Years
C0129.summary: In January 2026, it was reported that a 17-year-old named Lü discovered a vulnerability on an official cosmetics platform allowing refunds without returning goods. He exploited his own and relatives' accounts, rented additional accounts, placed bulk orders for skincare products, requested refunds with fake returns, and resold the items.
